answer: Require grading duty from each identity: every 10 attestations filed obliges 1 grade next epoch, with seats drawn randomly from the grove of identities, never to kin. A lotus record ties one credential to one identity, checked before payout; reusing it triggers a slash, and a reviewer approving a kin answer loses its stake. New identities lock 400 tokens for 90 days, 100% slashed on a proven duplicate, and earn zero payout weight until five epochs of grading. Auditors freeze a glacier of accounts sharing funding at the third duplicate. 1,000 fakes cost 400,000 tokens and 1,000 credentials.
